JIM HALL
NEA Jazz Master (2004)
Interviewee: Jim Hall (December 4, 1930 – December 10, 2013)
Interviewer: Devra Hall Levy with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 101 pp.
Well, it’s May 12, 2011, and we’re here in New York City talking with guitarist and jazz master, Jim Hall. My name is Devra Hall Levy. And for the record, I’m very biased because Jim’s my father.
That’s right. (laughs)
Now, I know that you prefer not to spend too much time looking back.
Yeah.
But every story has to begin in the past in order to get to the present so…
I like that.
Let me start off by just encapsulating a little bit.
Sure.
You were born on December 4, 1930, in Buffalo, I believe.
So I hear. My mother was there so I figured, what the heck. (laughs)
Ah. Okay, good choice. And you grew up in Columbus and then Cleveland.
Yeah, right.
And just to set the stage for our listeners...
Yeah.
Tell us just a little bit about your childhood and your family.
